s1.syndrome_frame: Sudden onset of oral and skin lesions with abdominal discomfort and difficulty eating, accompanied by extensive papillomatosis and verrucous plaques
salient_findings: Sudden warty growths over the lips
Extensive papillomatosis over the lips, tongue, and palate
Verrucous, velvety pigmented plaques in the axillae, posterior neck, periumbilical region, and groin folds
Ridged appearance and coarse texture of palms with papillomatous appearance
key_facts: 70-year-old woman
Sudden onset of oral lesions
Difficulty eating
6-month history of vague abdominal discomfort
Extensive papillomatosis over the lips, tongue, and palate
Verrucous, velvety pigmented plaques in multiple areas
Ridged appearance and coarse texture of palms
Abdominal CT showed large left-sided renal mass with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy
Thorax CT showed necrotic mediastinal lymphadenopathy causing superior vena cava compression
Biopsy of renal mass revealed invasive carcinoma with focal squamous differentiation

shortlist.label: Florid cutaneous papillomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of sudden onset of oral and skin lesions with extensive papillomatosis and verrucous plaques

shortlist.label: Tylosis with oesophageal cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Associated with esophageal cancer and could explain the abdominal discomfort and difficulty eating

shortlist.label: Urothelial carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Supported by the biopsy results of the renal mass showing invasive carcinoma with focal squamous differentiation

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible explanation for the oral lesions and could be related to the urothelial carcinoma

shortlist.label: Papillomatosis cutis carcinoides
shortlist.why_kept: Rare condition that could explain the combination of skin and oral lesions with an underlying malignancy

rule_in.why: age and sex are not specific

rule_out.why: age and sex are not specific to any candidate

trace.fact: Chief complaint: sudden warty growths over the lips

rule_in.why: it is directly associated with sudden warty growths

rule_out.why: it is unrelated to skin growths

rule_in.why: oral discomfort is more closely related to squamous cell carcinoma

rule_out.why: it is unrelated to oral discomfort
it is unrelated to eating difficulties

trace.fact: Time course: 6-month history of vague abdominal discomfort

rule_in.why: lesions are commonly found on the lips

rule_out.why: lesion location is outside urinary system

rule_in.why: it is most compatible with warty growths
oral discomfort is commonly associated with it
